definitions.explanation: Bacteria that turn sugar into lactic acid. They ferment yogurt, pickles, miso, and many other foods, and are widely advertised in Japan as good for the gut.

examples.japanese: {乳酸菌|にゅうさんきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Lactic acid bacteria are good for you.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヨーグルト→ヨーグルト：11133_yooguruto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{乳酸菌|にゅうさんきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Yogurt contains a lot of lactic acid bacteria.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧や⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発酵|はっこう}{食品|しょくひん}→発酵食品：16504_hakkoushokuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{乳酸菌|にゅうさんきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Many Japanese fermented foods, such as pickles and miso, are made through the action of lactic acid bacteria.

notes:
⟦{乳酸|にゅうさん}→乳酸：27900_nyuusan⟧ (lactic acid) + ⟦{菌|きん}→菌：02682_kin⟧ (bacteria). Common on food packaging and in health advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳酸菌|にゅうさんきん}{飲料|いんりょう}: lactic acid bacteria drink (such as Yakult)
- {乳酸菌|にゅうさんきん}{入|い}り: containing lactic acid bacteria
- {植物性|しょくぶつせい}{乳酸菌|にゅうさんきん}: plant-derived lactic acid bacteria

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{善玉菌|ぜんだまきん}→善玉菌：31942_zendamakin⟧: good bacteria — the gut-health category lactic acid bacteria belong to
- {悪玉菌|あくだまきん}: bad bacteria — the opposite category
- ビフィズス⟦{菌|きん}→菌：02682_kin⟧: bifidobacteria — another good-bacteria group, often paired with lactic acid bacteria
